paraphrase: Open analysis, analyst formulation (attribution deferred): whenever y moves x as moved (a per se link of a mover series), y is distinct from x, moves x in some respect, and is itself moved by something in some respect. It is the converse direction of STMT-SECOND-MOVERS-MOVE-ONLY-AS-MOVED, which gives only a sufficient condition for a per se link; it states a necessary condition and is neutral between the two senses of DISAMB-PER-SE-LINK.
